ruled_out_vectors.vector: Operator precedence: deposit0 | deposit1 == 0 in ModuleLiquidity.createPool
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Solidity 0.8.24 | has HIGHER precedence than ==, so expression parses as (deposit0 | deposit1) == 0 which is correct. Forge test confirms.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Operator precedence: minSqrtPriceX96 | maxSqrtPriceX96 == 0 in AMMStandardHook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Same Solidity 0.8.24 precedence rule. | > == so expression is correct. Forge test confirms.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Non-token hook fee key mismatch between _storeNonTokenHookFees and _transferHookFeesByHook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: By-design: non-token hooks store fees keyed by (tokenFor, tokenFor). Collection must use same key. API is misleading but not externally exploitable.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reentrancy during _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers via ERC-777 callback
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Requires ERC-777 token + custom hook. ENTERED bit prevents re-entering swap/liquidity. Double-claiming causes underflow. Self-inflicted by hook. Tier B prerequisite.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: afterSwap-only direct swap DoS when beforeSwap disabled
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Self-inflicted config: token admin controls their own flags. Only affects direct swaps. Admin can fix by enabling beforeSwap or removing bounds. FP pattern #4.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMStandardHook.sol:838-847 (self-inflicted config, no test needed)

ruled_out_vectors.vector: beforeSwap-only direct swap bounds bypass (HOOK-001 variant)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known CP-001 pattern. Token admin configures beforeSwap=ON, afterSwap=OFF. Self-inflicted. Already documented.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMStandardHook.sol:838-840 (known issue CP-001, no test needed)

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Core->PoolType: pool type returns amountOut > actual tokens (C5)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Core validates: actualAmountIn != 0, actualAmountIn <= originalAmountIn (revert at L1402), actualAmountOut <= originalAmountOut (revert at L1562). Reserve updates use _safeDecrementUint128.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Core->Handler: settlement conservation (C8)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Core uses strict balance-before/after check: balanceInBefore + amountIn != balanceInAfter -> revert. Handler must deliver exact amount.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Settings change between beforeSwap and afterSwap (C4)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: setTokenSettings uses nonReentrant modifier (L272). Cannot change settings during an active swap. Reentrancy flag bits verified non-overlapping.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Pool ID collision between different pool types (C13)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool type address encoded in bits 144-255 of poolId. Different pool types produce different poolIds. poolInitialized[] prevents duplicates.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Diamond storage slot collisions across facets (C15)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All facets (AMMModule, ModuleAdmin, ModuleFeeCollection, ModuleLiquidity) report 0 own storage slots. All use diamond storage at DIAMOND_STORAGE_LBAMM_VAULT (0x9A1D). Queued fee collect at separate slot.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Diamond selector collision across facets (C20)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Computed 4-byte selectors for all external/public functions across AMMModule, ModuleAdmin, ModuleFeeCollection, ModuleLiquidity. All unique. No collision with pool type selectors either.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Transient storage cross-path confusion (C21)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT only used in _validatePricingBounds for direct swaps. Not read by addLiquidity, removeLiquidity, or collectFees paths. No cross-operation-type confusion.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMStandardHook.sol:66,839,843-844 (tstore slot usage is single-path, no cross-path test needed)

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Hook/pool accounting desync after revert - Bunni pattern (C19)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Entire swap is atomic. If afterSwap reverts, beforeSwap state changes are also rolled back. No partial state persistence possible in Solidity's execution model.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMModule.sol:1372-1445 (EVM atomicity guarantee, no test needed)

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Hook return value manipulation - Uni V4 vectors (C22)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hooks can only return fee amounts (uint256). Fee bounded by swap amount at _applySwapByInputInputFees L2616. No swap parameter override capability unlike Uni V4.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Pool fee hook sees underflowed amount due to unchecked subtract (H-R2-DP-01)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Admin-gated: requires malicious token hook (set by token admin) AND stateful pool hook. Swap reverts anyway at fee check. No value extraction.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMModule.sol:1752-1758 (admin-gated, no external attacker path)

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flags cleared after executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers (H-R2-DP-07)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ENTERED bit remains set preventing re-entry into nonReentrant functions. Flag window is transient - _nonReentrantAfter restores NOT_ENTERED. No external function reads operation flags during this window.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Fee shortage amplification with extreme fees (H-R2-DP-06/H-R2-DP-10)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Input path: denominator=DOUBLE_BPS-poolFeeBPS*lpFeeBPS. At max valid values (poolFee=10000, lpFee=10000), denominator=0 but this combination makes expectedProtocolLPFee >= minimumProtocolFee so shortage branch never entered. Output path: denominator=MAX_BPS-hopFeeBPS, min=1 (hopFee max 9999). Amplification bounded ~10000x but limitAmount catches overpayment.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Protocol fee rounding accumulation drains reserves (H-R2-DP-05)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: mulDivRoundingUp used for protocolFeeFromInput may overshoot by 1 wei per swap. But total protocol fees are bounded by actual input collected (balance-checked at settlement). The rounding error per swap is at most 1 wei.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: SSTORE fallback stale pricing bounds (H-R2-TS-01)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Only affects chains where tstore is not supported (SSTORE fallback path). On cancun EVM (target chain), tstore is used and auto-clears at tx end. Even on SSTORE fallback, this is a variant of known CP-001 with same self-inflicted config prerequisite.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMStandardHook.sol:839,953 (non-cancun chain issue, out of scope for target)

theft_theses.thesis: Pool type returns inflated amountOut to credit user more than received
Transfer handler steals from settlement by under-delivering tokens
Hook fee callback returns manipulated fee to extract non-existent tokens
Fee shortage amplification steals from swappers via inflated amountIn
Protocol fee rounding accumulation enables reserve drain via collectProtocolFees
Reentrancy via ERC-777 during queued hook fee transfer enables double-claiming

Price convention is consistent: amount0/amount1 ordering follows tokenIn<tokenOut regardless of hook direction.

Division-by-zero unreachable: when poolFee*lpFee=DOUBLE_BPS, expectedProtocolLPFee >= minimumProtocolFee so shortage branch skipped.
ENTERED bit persists, blocking re-entry. Flag window transient, no exploitable code path.
